Pattern: be landlocked; a landlocked + N
Examples: A landlocked country depends on somebody else's port. | The lagoon is almost landlocked at low tide.

Pattern: be navigable; a navigable + N
Examples: The river is navigable for nine kilometres. | The channel is navigable only above half tide.

Pattern: be teeming + with + N
Examples: The pools are teeming with life in May. | The bank was once teeming with cod.

Pattern: head out; head out to + N
Examples: They headed out before the wind got up. | Nine boats headed out and six came back that night.

Pattern: dry out; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The creek dries out completely at low tide. | They let the nets dry out on the quay.

Pattern: break up; break + N + up; tách được
Examples: The wreck broke up in the first winter storm. | The ice broke up a month early.

Pattern: close in; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The fog closed in within minutes. | The weather closed in and they turned for home.

Pattern: stand off; stand off from + N
Examples: The ship stood off until the tide rose. | They stood off the reef all night.

Pattern: put in; put in at/to + N
Examples: They put in at the nearest harbour for repairs. | Nine vessels put in to shelter from the gale.

Pattern: blow over; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The gale blew over by morning. | They waited for it to blow over and lost two days.

Pattern: keep + N + afloat; tách được
Examples: Two pumps kept the boat afloat. | The grant kept the lifeboat station afloat for a decade.

Pattern: the ebb and flow + of + N
Examples: The ebb and flow of the trade governs the whole town. | They live by the ebb and flow of the tide.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; sea fog + rolls in
Examples: Sea fog rolls in with a warm wind over cold water. | Sea fog closed the airfield for nine hours.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + spring tide + floods
Examples: A spring tide with an easterly wind floods the quay. | Spring tides come twice a month.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + neap tide + barely moves
Examples: At neap tide the range is only two metres. | They dredge on a neap tide when the current is slack.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; a + rip current + pulls
Examples: A rip current pulls swimmers sideways, not down. | Nine rescues that summer involved a rip current.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; organise/a + beach clean
Examples: The beach clean filled ninety sacks. | A beach clean every month keeps the dunes usable.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; go + sea angling
Examples: Sea angling from the pier needs a permit now. | Sea angling brings more money ashore than the trawlers.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; paddle/a + sea kayak
Examples: A sea kayak reaches coves no boat can enter. | Nine sea kayaks crossed the sound together.

Pattern: be + plain sailing
Examples: After the permit it was plain sailing. | The first season was plain sailing and the second was not.

Pattern: be + out of one's depth
Examples: The new committee was out of its depth by the autumn. | He was out of his depth with the accounts.

Pattern: make waves
Examples: Her report made waves in every department. | The appointment made waves and then made sense.

Pattern: test the waters
Examples: They tested the waters with a single trial route. | She tested the waters before resigning.

Pattern: go overboard + with + N
Examples: They went overboard with the signage and forgot the benches. | Nobody needs to go overboard; two coats will do.

Pattern: be + all at sea
Examples: The new committee was all at sea for a year. | He was all at sea with the paperwork.

Pattern: be + a sea change + in + N
Examples: There has been a sea change in how the catch is sold. | A sea change in attitude took one generation.

Definition: chỉ mới chạm đến bề nổi
Pattern: scratch the surface + of + N
Examples: The survey only scratches the surface of the problem. | Nine complaints scratch the surface of what was happening.

Definition: cầm cự cho qua cơn khó khăn
Pattern: ride out the storm
Examples: The yard rode out the storm by taking repair work. | They rode out the storm and lost two boats.

Pattern: be + in the same boat
Examples: Every small port is in the same boat. | They were in the same boat and competed anyway.

Pattern: be/feel like + a fish out of water
Examples: He was a fish out of water in that office. | She felt like a fish out of water for the first month.

Pattern: the coast is clear
Examples: They waited until the coast was clear and sailed. | The coast is clear now the inspection is over.

Definition: đi sát lằn ranh phạm luật
Pattern: sail close to the wind
Examples: The accounts sailed close to the wind for years. | He sails close to the wind and has never been caught.

Pattern: rock the boat
Examples: Nobody wanted to rock the boat before the sale. | She rocked the boat and the practice stopped.

Pattern: batten down the hatches
Examples: They battened down the hatches for a lean winter. | Battening down the hatches saved the business.
